heading: 16.5 `units.currency`
text:
### 16.5 `units.currency` [LUNI.16.5]

This module is deferred with currency ([LUNI.13.11]). It will declare three
anchor currencies — **USD, EUR, CNY** (the People's Republic Yuan Renminbi, ISO
4217 code `CNY`, colloquially "RMB") — with the **full directed conversion
graph** between them (six `unit fx_pair` declarations). All three sit in ISO
4217's 2-dp tier; storage is `int64` cents / fen.

The companion `FxRate` schema ([LUNI.13.3]) will be declared here so an
integrator can publish rate facts without re-declaring the contract. Detailed
semantics — rounding rules, conversion via `unit fx_pair`, where rates come from
— are [LUNI.13]'s.

The wider ISO 4217 set (0-dp currencies like JPY / KRW / ISK / CLP, 3-dp Gulf
dinars KWD / BHD / JOD / OMR, and the rest of the ~178 codes), the sub-minor
precision tiers (`currency_<ccy>_4dp` for FX pip precision, `currency_<ccy>_8dp`
for sub-pip), and crypto dimensions are outside the module. Explicit rounding
([LUNI.13.5]) and cross-currency comparison ([LUNI.13.7]) apply to any declared
currency dimension. Crypto currencies need precision beyond `int64`.
